Ivy CSM: Alto renewal due 04/12. Procurement flagged two items: they need vendor onboarding attached to the PO and the internal AP wants a specific vendor code ALTO-22, while our quote lists RDW-NORTH. amount is $221,400.
Marc RevOps: can you paste quote meta? invoice id, billing entity, vendor code we used?
Ivy CSM: Quote: Q-2026-9032, Invoice target INV-2026-2201, Billing entity Redwood Inference, Inc., Amount $221,400, Our vendor code RDW-NORTH, Requested PO ref ALTO-BPO-04-12.
Ryan (Alto): confirmed AP shows ALTO-22. They also require wet signature on any amendment over $200k.
Liam Finance: we can map external vendor code in a reference field but need Alto to keep vendor name as Redwood Inference, Inc. in their vendor master. If they insist on ALTO-22 as vendor master, we'll need an internal memo.
Helen Legal: contract side okay with vendor code change if billing entity/tax id unchanged. Need written approval from Alto. @Ivy please capture procurement email.
esign-bot: DocuSign envelope created: https://docusign.example/envelope/alto-789 - status sent to Ryan 2026-04-02 10:15 UTC.
Ivy CSM: action items: 1) ask Alto procurement to attach onboarding packet to PO, 2) get written approval for vendor code mapping if they want ALTO-22 as master, 3) wet-sign logistics ready if amendment remains >$200k.
Ryan (Alto): procurement will attach onboarding and try to accept RDW-NORTH with ALTO-22 in PO ref. CFO prefers wet signature but can approve e-sign in writing. I'll push for e-sign to speed up.
Marc RevOps: timeline: need signed amendment + PO by 04/05 to process billing. If wet-sign needed, allow 3 business days for courier.
Ivy CSM: noted. I'll upload any approval emails here and mark checklist. Keeping this thread as single source of truth for the renewal.
